PART_AC_PASSIVE_MASTERY_02.Description: Critical strikes increase the damage dealt by Karma Breaker's damage over time by 10% until the debuff ends or is refreshed

PART_AC_PASSIVE_MASTERY_03.Description: Surge deals +25% damage. After surging, gain +5% movespeed for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.

PART_AC_SPECIAL_DEFAULT.Description: Unleash energy in a focused blast, dealing 900 damage to the first enemy hit. Deals up to +100% damage when Tempest Form and Karma Breaker's effects are active.

PART_AC_SPECIAL_MASTERY.Description: Unleash energy forward in a pressure wave, dealing 500 damage to the closest target and 166 damage to up to 2 other nearby targets. Deals up to +100% damage when Tempest Form and Karma Breaker's effects are active.

PART_AC_SPECIAL_BULWARK.Description: Unleash energy forward in a pressure wave, dealing 500 damage to the closest target. Grant self and nearby allies up to 2 Defense when Tempest Form and Karma Breaker's effects are active.

PART_CB_PASSIVE_BLENDER.Description: Using Blade Spin grants stacking on-next hit damage that is consumed when using other attacks.

PART_DP_BARREL_BLAZE.Description: Shots and abilities deal blaze damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_DEFAULT.Description: Shots and abilities deal neutral damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_DEFAULT_PAX.Description: Shots and abilities deal physical damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_EXOTIC_BOMBS.Description: While Empowered, gain +40% critical strike chance instead of bonus damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_ALLURING_MOONS.Description: Summons a random raptor to fight with you for a limited time.

PART_DP_BARREL_RADIANT_01.Description: While Empowered, gain +40% critical strike chance instead of bonus damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_FROST.Description: Shots and abilities deal frost damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_RADIANT.Description: Shots and abilities deal radiant damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_SHOCK.Description: Shots and abilities deal shock damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_TERRA.Description: Shots and abilities deal terra damage.

PART_DP_BARREL_UMBRAL.Description: Shots and abilities deal umbral damage.

PART_DP_GRIP_DEFAULT.Description: Launches a collectible buff a short distance, granting 15% increased attack speed for 15 seconds when collected. Empowered: Grants the same buff to all Slayers.

PART_DP_GRIP_DEFAULT_PAX.Description: Launches a collectible buff a short distance, granting 15% increased damage and attack speed for 12 seconds when collected. Empowered: Grants the same buff to all Slayers.

PART_DP_GRIP_EXOTIC_BOMBS.Description: Dash in a direction, becoming invulnerable for the duration. After dodging through an attack, fire 6 mini-shots that always crit. While in Mag Bomb mode, fires 2 Mag Bombs instead.

PART_DP_GRIP_MINE.Description: Launches an explosive mine that deals 400 damage. Mine charges after a short period, increasing damage to 700. Empowered: Deals 900 damage when charged and can interrupt Behemoths.

PART_DP_GRIP_ALLURING_MOONS.Description: Summons a random raptor to fight with you for a limited time.

PART_DP_GRIP_SHOT_BUFFER.Description: Throws a shot-enhancing prism a short distance.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_EXOTIC_BOMBS.Description: After a critical strike, reduce the cooldown of Mag Bomb mode by 3 seconds.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_HOST.Description: The last 4 shots in your magazine generate a Frost Sprite that cause your next attack to deal 50 bonus damage and minor frost damage. Max 4 Sprites.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_SALLY.Description: After spending 100 stamina, next attack emits a cone of flame that deals +[MAGNITUDE] blaze damage to each unique targets within the cone

PART_DP_PASSIVE_MCROLLIN.Description: Once charged, your next attack places a frost brand that deals [MAGNITUDE] frost damage after 30 seconds. Slayers can destroy the brand, prematurely detonating it for 50% increased damage. Charges every 90 seconds.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_SCISSOR.Description: Once charged, your next attack unleashes whirling blades that deal [MAGNITUDE] terra damage. Additional attacks speed up the blades, which explode at the end of the duration and deal damage based on blade speed

PART_DP_PASSIVE_BEAVER.Description: Periodically enter a rage, dealing +[MAGNITUDE_PERCENT] damage and gaining immunity to stagger. Taking damage causes you to enrage more quickly.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_LAVAROLLER.Description: The tenth hit in quick succession deals 250 bonus damage and major blaze damage

PART_DP_PASSIVE_LOW_AMMO_CRIT.Description: Grants 2% critical strike chance for each round missing from the magazine.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_LOW_AMMO_MOVESPEED.Description: Gain 20% increased movespeed when at 6 or less ammo.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_MARKSMAN_DAMAGE.Description: Deal 8 increased damage when attacking the same part multiple times. Stacks up to 5 times.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_MARKSMAN_DAMAGE_PAX.Description: Deal 8 increased damage when attacking the same part multiple times. Stacks up to 5 times.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_PDODGE_COOLDOWNS.Description: Reduce both ability cooldowns by 2 seconds when dodging through behemoth attacks.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_ROCK_ALPHA.Description: Dealing damage has a chance (based on damage dealt) to grant a stacking, refreshing 40 health shield that lasts for 12s.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_SALT.Description: Once charged, your next attack will deal 550 bonus radiant damage. Charge rate increases with current health.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_SHADOWCAT.Description: Dealing damage has a chance (based on damage dealt) to generate a shadow orb that increases damage dealt by 2.5% for 5 seconds. If 5 or more orbs are present, the bonus doubles

PART_DP_PASSIVE_SNOWFLAKE.Description: Evading drops {MAGNITUDE} Ice Mine on a 30 second cooldown.

PART_DP_PASSIVE_TRIALS_01.Description: Empowered Reloading at exactly 0 ammo decreases the cooldown of both abilities by 4 seconds.

PART_DP_RECEIVER_DEFAULT_PAX.Description: Fires an explosive missile in a line, dealing 400 damage in an area upon impact. Empowered: Fires 3 missiles in a spread.

PART_DP_RECEIVER_EXOTIC_BOMBS.Description: Load 8 Mag Bombs into your magazine. They attach to enemies and are detonated on Reload. The first Mag Bomb attached to each Behemoth part deals +300 damage.

PART_DP_RECEIVER_PIERCING.Description: Fires a piercing bolt in a line, dealing damage thats falls as it travels. Empowered: Deals greatly increased damage and pushes the slayer backwards.

PART_EB_PASSIVE_DODGE_ATTACK.Description: Dealing damage with Bladerush restores 20 stamina and generates 3 Valour over 9 seconds. Does not stack.

PART_EB_PASSIVE_RADIANT_01.Description: Dealing damage with Bladerush restores 20 stamina and generates 3 Valour over 9 seconds. Does not stack.

PART_EB_PASSIVE_STAGGERPROOF.Description: Each Valour gained or spent restores 30 health.

PART_EB_PASSIVE_TRIALS_02.Description: After using any Valour combo, your next Valour combo within 5 seconds deals +30% damage.

PART_EB_SPECIAL_CROWBEAR_EXOTIC.Description: Hunger - Activate at full meter to enter the Feast, gaining the effects of Valiant Overdrive, +25% damage and +12% lifesteal. Health is constantly drained. Dashing also grants invulnerability.

PART_EB_SPECIAL_DEFAULT.Description: Activate at full meter to enter Overdrive, gaining +20% attack speed and causing attacks to deal +60-80 aoe damage. Grants 1 Valour immediately and then 1 Valour every 4 seconds. Reactivate to dash in a direction (Costs 1 Valour).

PART_EB_SPECIAL_PARRY.Description: Activate at full meter to enter Overdrive, gaining +20% attack speed and causing attacks to deal +60-80 aoe damage. Reactivate to parry and riposte a Behemoth attack, dealing 800 damage and granting 1 Valour when successful (2 second cooldown).

PART_EB_SPECIAL_RADIANT_01.Description: Activate at full meter to enter Overdrive, gaining +20% attack speed and causing attacks to deal +60-80 aoe damage. Reactivate to parry and riposte a Behemoth attack, dealing 800 damage and granting 1 Valour when successful (2 second cooldown).

PART_EB_SPECIAL_SPIN.Description: Activate at full meter to spin, becoming unstaggerable and dealing 80 damage constantly to nearby enemies. Grants 1 Valour every 4 seconds. Reactivate to slash in a direction, dealing 500 + (20 x number of spin hits) to the first enemy hit.

PART_GA_PASSIVE_CHARGE_AOE.Description: Charging attack deals aoe damage to nearby enemies at each charge level.

PART_GA_PASSIVE_CHARGING_MOVESPEED.Description: Movespeed while charging Horizontal Attacks is now increased instead of decreased and costs no stamina to maintain.

PART_GA_PASSIVE_METER.Description: Determination can now stack up to 4 times.

PART_GA_PASSIVE_TRIALS_01.Description: Tonics consumed while your axe is thrown have +50% effectiveness.

PART_GA_PASSIVE_TRIALS_02.Description: Perfectly charged attacks grants +15 meter on hit, but no longer grant resolve

PART_GA_SPECIAL_DEFAULT.Description: Throw the axe, dealing 60 damage constantly and gaining 2 meter per hit. Reactivate to recall it and perform a powerful attack that deals up to 500 damage (further increased by determinaton) and gain 15 meter.

PART_GA_SPECIAL_SKILLSHOT.Description: Hurl the axe forward, dealing up to 800 damage (further increased by determination) to enemies in its path and gaining 15 meter when hitting a Behemoth. Catch the axe to gain 30 meter.

PART_GA_SPECIAL_SKILLSHOT_RESET.Description: Hurl the axe forward, damaging enemies in its path. Catch the axe to throw it again up to 2 more times in the next 5 seconds, dealing 500/600/1000 damage (further increased by determination). Does not build meter.

PART_IH_PASSIVE_JUMP_ATTACK_BUFF.Description: Aerial Strike grants increased damage dealt for 10 seconds. Bonus is doubled if a Behemoth's head is struck.

PART_IH_PASSIVE_STAGGER_PASSTHROUGH.Description: Stagger damage is no longer halved when attacking Behemoth legs.

PART_IH_PASSIVE_TRIALS_01.Description: Ammo decreased to 2, but bonus from aethercharged ammo is increased by 300%.

PART_IH_PASSIVE_TRIALS_02.Description: Priming attacks increases attack speed by 10% until the combo ends. Stacks.

PART_IH_SPECIAL_DEFAULT.Description: Hold to load ammo into the hammer. Release to unleash a blast that deals up to 360 damage based on ammo loaded and can interrupt behemoths. Range increases with ammo loaded.

PART_IH_SPECIAL_ISLANDCRACKER.Description: Hold to load ammo into the hammer. Release to create an aether vent that buffs players who step over it, granting them up to +35% damage based on ammo quality.

PART_IH_SPECIAL_ISLANDCRACKER_DEFENSIVE.Description: Hold to load ammo into the hammer. Release to create an aether vent that buffs players who step over it, granting them +40% damage reduction and up to 155 healing over 30 seconds when aethercharged.

PART_IH_SPECIAL_SALLY_EXOTIC.Description: Converts all explosive uses of ammo into fireball attacks that deal damage based on ammo quality.

PART_IH_SPECIAL_SKIES_OF_OSTIA.Description: Converts ammo into shock attacks that fire more based on ammo spent.

PART_MS_PASSIVE_TRIALS_01.Description: After a dodge piercing attack, gain +50% wound damage for 8 seconds.

PART_MS_SPECIAL_BEAM.Description: Use to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo to channel a beam that damages Behemoths the more it remains damaging them.

PART_MS_SPECIAL_PROJECTILE.Description: Press to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo to fire a missile that deals up to 1200 damage based on ammo quality and can interrupt Behemoths.

PART_MS_SPECIAL_ROCKETLUNGE.Description: Press to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo and perform a flying lunge attack that deals up to 1500 damage based on distance and ammo quality.
